# benchmark-memory-conflict

> Household memory conflicts: latest preference, privacy, authority, reversible bookings.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-memory-conflict
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-memory-conflict
Directory: https://private-repo-337e.com/benchmarks/benchmark-memory-conflict

## Tasks

40 episode tasks in data/tasks.jsonl. Generator: node scripts/gen-tasks.mjs --seed 20261015
Hidden eval split: node scripts/gen-tasks.mjs --seed <unpublished> --split hidden (not committed).
Alternate splits: --tasks <path> on the CLI, tasks arg on MCP tools, ?tasks=<path> on API routes (inside package or BMC_TASKS_ALLOW).

## Tools (simulator)

search_options, book, cancel, ask_user, read_memory, write_memory

## Grading

Deterministic replay. See docs/grading.md. Metrics: staleMemoryUsed, privacyLeak, askedWhenNeeded.

## Commands

npm run ci:local — lint, typecheck, build, e2e (artifacts/e2e-report.json)
npx benchmark-memory-conflict run --model offline --provider mock

## Exports

Root: benchmark, createBenchmark, run, score. Subpaths: benchmark-memory-conflict/api (handler), benchmark-memory-conflict/mcp.
